edits.old: No new screen. The allocation view of SCR-38 Decision log query shows, for one case or one business date, the rule ID and version, the final call, the assignment rule ID and version, the queue, the owner, the decided time and the chain result; the case number and queue code beside them are read from the rwb-case contract at display time. Its states are Loading, Results, Empty ("No decisions match this search.") and Error with MSG-P7-003; a broken link puts a warning at the top and leaves the entry in place. The screen itself, its filters beyond the four query parameters, its paging and its export are legacy RWB-E2-005's, served by the gateway-bff composite route (DP-19), which calls this service for the entries and rwb-case for the case header.
edits.new: No new screen. The allocation view of SCR-38 Decision log query shows, for one case or one business date, the rule ID and version, the final call, the assignment rule ID and version, the queue, the owner, the decided time and the chain result; the case number and queue code beside them are read from the rwb-case contract at display time. Its states are Loading, Results, Empty, Error and No access; the Empty, Error and No access states, their wording and MSG-P7-003 are Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-6904), and a broken link puts a warning at the top and leaves the entry in place. The screen itself, its filters beyond the four query parameters, its paging and its export are legacy RWB-E2-005's, served by the gateway-bff composite route (DP-19), which calls this service for the entries and rwb-case for the case header.
